messages:
samuel: new model intake — sirocco-13b landed in staging. TL;DR: we need a quick gating pass focused on quantized 8-bit vs fp16 quality delta for our chat templates + tool-calling flows. Can folks volunteer to run the smoke checklist today? @mira @kevin

mira: happy to run quant bench. I'll do 1) base fp16 eval on eval-suite v3 2) int8 qlora run with current quant profile 3) run 5 chat templates incl toolcall

kevin: i'll own API integration tests: streaming + function calling correctness, schema validation, and structured-output regression checks

lina: i'll do regression metrics and alert thresholds. probes: exact-match for tool outputs, embedding-similarity for semantics, hallucination probe

ops-bot: deploy ci/job 4321 queued by samuel

samuel: quick checklist (short):
- model metadata: source, commit-ish, architecture, tokenization notes
- quant runs: profile, seed, per-layer exceptions, checksum of quant artifacts
- prompts: canonical chat templates (system, user, assistant), and explicit tool-schema examples
- evals: smoke set, heavy set, canary set; compute unit costs and p50/p95 latencies
- infra: batch sizes, KV cache warmup, perf SLO targets
- fallback: smaller model variant + strict schema enforcement (drop/flag invalid outputs)

mira: quick note on prompts: avoid brittle parsing. require explicit keys so schema parsing is deterministic. example template we use in evals:
```
SYSTEM: You are an assistant that always returns JSON with keys: action_name, args
USER: "Create a calendar event for tomorrow 3pm about team sync"
ASSISTANT: {"action_name":"create_event","args":{"title":"team sync","time":"2025-07-12T15:00"}}
```

kevin: API snippet for our chat endpoint (pseudo):
```
POST /v1/chat
{
  "model": "sirocco-13b-8bit",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"..."}, {"role":"user","content":"..."}],
  "stream": true,
  "tools": [{"name":"calendar","schema": {"title":"string", "time": "string"}}]
}
```
kevin: notes: validate schema server-side and drop unknown keys before forwarding to tool. use `function_call` when forcing tool invocation. ensure streaming handles partial JSON and reassembles to validate final schema

lina: regression metrics proposal:
- exact match rate for tool args (strict key/value equality)
- semantic similarity (embedding cosine) for free-text responses to catch subtle degradation
- latency p50/p95 and token cost delta per request template
- alert if tool-arg exact-match drops >3% or hallucination score >0.08

mira: perf notes: int8 gave ~1.9x token throughput improvement on our profile, but a few templates showed length-dependent quality drop. KV cache warmup reduces short-convo p50 significantly

samuel: decision: prioritize quant bench this week. owners: mira (quant), kevin (api tests), lina (evals). timeline: smoke by EOD, full bench by Friday. If any regression >5% open revert+canary and tag infra/product

kevin: i'll add an automated smoke test in the repo: tests/chat_toolcall_smoke.py — will ping when ready :thumbsup:

mira: started quant job, attaching minimal log snippet for context:
```
[2025-07-12 09:12:03] quantize: layers 1..512 done
[2025-07-12 09:15:22] eval_smoke: tool_exact_match_fp16=0.944 tool_exact_match_int8=0.931
```

lina: noted, i'll run eval harness against artifacts and push a short report to the model intake ticket (INTAKE-879)

samuel: perfect. if anyone finds structured-output drift, drop a failing example in the ticket and tag @samuel. also include minimal reproducer (messages array + model name + seed)

kevin: PR #842 created with smoke test and schema fixtures

mira: job finished; artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/sirocco-13b/2025-07-12/
ops-bot: artifact upload complete: 1.2GB

lina: first-pass report: tool arg exact-match delta = -1.3% (int8 vs fp16), hallucination probe unchanged; pushing full metrics shortly

samuel: ack. i'll validate numbers and schedule a canary deploy tomorrow morning. :rocket:
